## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text preserves the ninth fascicle of a longer (possibly originally 9- or 10-fascicle) Yáo-Qín *Dà yún* tradition translation by [竺佛念](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E4%BD%9B%E5%BF%B5) Zhú Fóniàn, parallel to but distinct from [曇無讖](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9B%87%E7%84%A1%E8%AE%96) Dharmakṣema's *Dà fāng děng wú xiǎng jīng* 大方等無想經 ([KR6g0033](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0033), T0387). Only juan 9 survives.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to Zhú Fóniàn's Yáo-Qín period (365–411 CE).
